sentences.en: Fair competition is necessary for the healthy growth of industry.
sentences.zh: 公平竞争对于行业的健康发展是必要的。

sentences.en: The doctor examined the child and said she was healthy.
sentences.zh: 医生检查了这个孩子，并说她很健康。

sentences.en: If I were healthy, I could go on a hike.
sentences.zh: 如果我身体健康的话，我可以去远足。

senses.zh: 健康的，身体好的；有益健康的；正常的，良好的
